PHBMeasurement.description: One source's brightness in one band.

BAND_ID.description: Band identifier; resolves to a `$PHB` BAND_ID.

SPECTRAL_REGIME.description:
Coarse region of the band, copied from its descriptor so a consumer
can select a mode without resolving the band.

WAVELENGTH_EFF_NM.description:
Effective wavelength of the band, nanometres (vacuum). Copied from the
descriptor; required for synthesis when the descriptor is not at hand.

MAGNITUDE_SYSTEM.description: Calibration system when QUANTITY is MAGNITUDE.

UNCERTAINTY.description: One-sigma uncertainty of VALUE, same units.

EPOCH_MJD.description:
Mid-time of the observation, Modified Julian Date (TT), for sources
whose brightness varies. Absent for a catalogue mean.

OBSERVATION_COUNT.description: Number of observations averaged into VALUE; 0 when unstated.

PHB.description: Photometric Band: one passband's place on the spectrum and its calibration.

BAND_ID.description:
Stable band identifier, unique within the publishing catalogue, e.g.
"V", "Ks", "0.5-2keV", "1.4GHz". Measurements refer to it.

SYSTEM_NAME.description:
Name of the photometric system the band belongs to, as the defining
publication states it.

WAVELENGTH_MIN_NM.description: Short edge of the band at half maximum response, nanometres.

WAVELENGTH_MAX_NM.description: Long edge of the band at half maximum response, nanometres.

MAGNITUDE_SYSTEM.description: Calibration system of magnitudes stated in the band.

ZERO_POINT_JY.description:
Flux density at the effective wavelength of a zero-magnitude source,
janskys.

RESPONSE_WAVELENGTH_NM.description: Wavelengths the response curve is sampled at, nanometres, ascending.

RESPONSE.description:
Relative system response at each RESPONSE_WAVELENGTH_NM sample,
peak-normalised to 1. Photon-counting unless RESPONSE_IS_ENERGY.

RESPONSE_IS_ENERGY.description: True when RESPONSE is an energy-counting response.

CITATION.description: Reference to the publication that defines the band.

DEFINITION_URL.description: URL of the band's defining document or response table.

SKTPoint.description: One point source packed for drawing (24 bytes).

RA_FIXED.description:
Right ascension (or longitude in FRAME) as a fraction of a full turn:
degrees = RA_FIXED * 360 / 2^32.

DEC_FIXED.description: Declination (or latitude in FRAME): degrees = DEC_FIXED * 90 / 2^31.

PMRA.description:
Proper motion in RA times cos(DEC), milliarcseconds per year. -32768
when unknown or out of range (FLAGS bit 2).

PMDEC.description:
Proper motion in DEC, milliarcseconds per year. -32768 when unknown or
out of range (FLAGS bit 2).

PARALLAX.description:
Parallax in units of 0.02 milliarcseconds. 0 when unknown, not
positive or out of range (FLAGS bit 3).

MAG.description: Magnitude in the tile's band, millimagnitudes. -32768 when unknown.

COLOR.description: Colour, encoded as the tile's COLOR_ENCODING states.

FLAGS.description:
Bit flags. 0: variable. 1: member of a multiple system. 2: PMRA/PMDEC
not usable. 3: PARALLAX not usable. 4: MAG is modelled, not measured.
5: ROW refers to a `$CSO` rather than a `$STR`. 6: a neighbour lies
within the confusion radius. 7: extended source. 8-15: reserved, 0.

ROW.description:
Index of the source's full record in the tile's row collection
(ROW_COLLECTION_CID), from 0. 0xFFFFFFFF when the tile has none.

SKT.description: Sky Tile: one HEALPix tile of an all-sky point-source or diffuse-map layer.

LAYER_ID.description:
Stable identifier of the layer: equal across every tile of one
(producer, source catalogue or survey, band, place, epoch).

FRAME.description: Frame the HEALPix grid and the point positions are stated in.

MAX_ORDER.description:
Deepest order of the layer, when the producer knows it; 255 when
unstated.

CHILD_MASK.description:
Which of the four children exist (bit i for child 4 * PIXEL + i). 0 on
a leaf.

REFINE.description: How the tile relates to its ancestors and children.

SPECTRAL_REGIME.description: Coarse spectral region of the band.

BAND_ID.description:
Band identifier; resolves to a `$PHB` BAND_ID. MAG and map values are
in this band.

WAVELENGTH_EFF_NM.description: Effective wavelength of the band, nanometres (vacuum).

WAVELENGTH_MIN_NM.description: Short edge of a band-integrated map, nanometres.

WAVELENGTH_MAX_NM.description: Long edge of a band-integrated map, nanometres.

EPOCH.description: Epoch of point positions, Julian years (TT).

OBSERVER_ID.description:
Observer an ASTROMETRIC or APPARENT tile was computed for (a site, a
spacecraft or the geocentre), as the producer names it.

POINT_COUNT.description: Number of points in the payload.

MAG_LIMIT.description:
Faintest magnitude in the tile; with the ancestors, the layer is
complete to this limit inside the pixel.

COLOR_BLUE_BAND_ID.description: Bluer band of a COLOR_INDEX colour.

COLOR_RED_BAND_ID.description: Redder band of a COLOR_INDEX colour.

ROW_COLLECTION_CID.description:
Content identifier of the full `$STR` / `$CSO` records of the points,
a size-prefixed record sequence in ROW order.

MAP_DEPTH.description: Order offset of the map pixels: the tile holds 4^MAP_DEPTH values.

MAP_QUANTITY_NAME.description: Producer's name for the quantity when MAP_QUANTITY is OTHER.

MAP_UNITS.description:
Units of the physical map values, UCUM style (e.g. "K", "MJy/sr",
"count/s/sr").

MAP_SCALE.description: Scale of a scaled integer encoding.

MAP_OFFSET.description: Offset of a scaled integer encoding.

MAP_BLANK.description: Raw value marking a pixel with no data in a scaled integer encoding.

MAP_VALUES.description: Raw map bytes, 4^MAP_DEPTH values in nested order.

STRETCH_SOFTENING.description: Softening of an ASINH stretch, in physical units.

PERCENTILE_LEVELS.description:
Percentile levels of the layer's value distribution, in [0, 100],
ascending.

PERCENTILE_VALUES.description:
Physical value at each PERCENTILE_LEVELS entry. Computed over the whole
layer, so every tile stretches alike.

PAYLOAD_CID.description: Content identifier of the payload when POINTS and MAP_VALUES are absent.

PAYLOAD_BYTES.description: Length of the payload at PAYLOAD_CID, bytes.

OBSERVATION_START.description: Start of the observations the tile summarises, ISO 8601 UTC.

OBSERVATION_END.description: End of the observations the tile summarises, ISO 8601 UTC.

SOURCE_NAMES.description: Verbatim names of the catalogues or surveys the tile was derived from.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that produced the tile.

PRODUCED_AT.description: Time the tile was produced, ISO 8601 UTC.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publishers ask for.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms of the source data.

SKQDetection.description: A star detected by a camera: a direction in the camera frame.

X.description: Direction in the camera frame; any non-zero length.

BRIGHTNESS.description: Relative brightness; larger is brighter. Orders the detections.

SKQTrack.description: A body's apparent path across the sky over an interval, and its disc.

START_RA_DEG.description: Direction of the body's centre at the start of the interval.

END_RA_DEG.description: Direction at the end; equal to the start for an instant.

RADIUS_DEG.description: Angular radius of the body's disc.

BODY_ID.description: Caller's identifier for the body, echoed in the result.

SKQPointing.description: A sensor pointing to check for bright stars.

POINTING_ID.description: Caller's identifier for the pointing, echoed in the result.

SKQ.description: Sky Query: one question to a star and compact-source catalogue for an observer and epoch.

QUERY_ID.description: Caller's identifier, echoed in the result.

EPOCH_JD_TT.description: Whole part of the epoch, Julian Date (TT).

OBSERVER_ID.description: Name of the observer, carried into tiles and results.

OBSERVER_POSITION_M.description: Observer's geocentric position on GCRS axes, metres; three entries.

OBSERVER_VELOCITY_M_PER_S.description:
Observer's geocentric velocity on GCRS axes, metres per second; three
entries.

BAND_ID.description:
Band magnitudes are stated in and limited by; resolves to a `$PHB`
BAND_ID.

MAG_LIMIT.description: Faintest magnitude reported. Absent: no limit.

MAX_RESULTS.description: Largest number of rows reported; 0 for no cap.

TILE_ORDER.description: APPARENT_PLACES: HEALPix order of the output tiles.

COLOR_ENCODING.description: APPARENT_PLACES: what each point's COLOR holds.

COLOR_BLUE_BAND_ID.description: APPARENT_PLACES: bands of a COLOR_INDEX colour.

LAYER_ID.description: APPARENT_PLACES: LAYER_ID of the output tiles.

RA_DEG.description: CONE and FIELD_OF_VIEW: centre or boresight.

HALF_WIDTH_DEG.description: FIELD_OF_VIEW: half-extent along the field's x axis.

HALF_HEIGHT_DEG.description: FIELD_OF_VIEW: half-extent along the field's y axis.

ROLL_DEG.description: FIELD_OF_VIEW: position angle of the field's +y axis, east of north.

TOLERANCE_ARCSEC.description: IDENTIFY: largest angle between a detection and its catalogue star.

MAX_FIELD_DEG.description: IDENTIFY: largest angle between two detections (the field diagonal).

MAG_THRESHOLD.description: BRIGHT_STAR_EXCLUSION: rows at least this bright exclude a pointing.

SKRHit.description: A row that answers a CONE or FIELD_OF_VIEW query.

FLAGS.description: SKTPoint FLAGS bits for the row.

SEPARATION_DEG.description: Angle from the centre or boresight.

FIELD_X_DEG.description:
Field coordinates: angles along the field's x and y axes (the
standard coordinates of a cone query). NaN behind the tangent plane.

MAG.description: Magnitude in the query's band; NaN when unknown.

SKROccultation.description: A row a body's disc passes over.

MIN_SEPARATION_DEG.description: Closest approach of the body's centre to the row.

TRACK_FRACTION.description:
Where along the track the closest approach falls, from 0 (start) to 1
(end).

VIOLATING_COUNT.description: Rows within the radius at least as bright as the threshold.

BRIGHTEST_ROW.description: The brightest of them; 4294967295 when there are none.

SKR.description: Sky Query Result: the answer to one `$SKQ`.

EPOCH_JD_TT.description: Epoch and reduction the answer is for, copied from the query.

ROWS_ADDED.description: INGEST: rows added by the ingest answered.

MATCHED_COUNT.description: CONE and FIELD_OF_VIEW: rows matched before MAX_RESULTS applied.

BAND_IDS.description: SYNTHETIC_PHOTOMETRY: bands of the table's columns.

MAGNITUDES.description: SYNTHETIC_PHOTOMETRY: ROW_COUNT x BAND_IDS magnitudes, row-major.

DERIVATIONS.description: SYNTHETIC_PHOTOMETRY: how each magnitude was obtained, same layout.

ROTATION.description: IDENTIFY: camera-to-GCRS rotation, nine entries, row-major.

QUATERNION.description: IDENTIFY: the same rotation as (w, x, y, z).

RESIDUAL_RMS_ARCSEC.description: IDENTIFY: RMS angle between matched detections and their rows.

BORESIGHT_RA_DEG.description: IDENTIFY: direction of the camera's +z axis.

MATCHED_ROWS.description:
IDENTIFY: row matched to each detection, in detection order;
4294967295 when unmatched.
